create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured with a Hugging Face router base URL and access token
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request using the OpenAI client to call a Hugging Face inference model
configure_hf_model: configure a Hugging Face model ID with hf-inference suffix for chat completion
send_user_message: send a user message with role and content to a Hugging Face inference endpoint
parse_completion_response: parse the chat completion response to extract the assistant message from choices
